newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek inflation eases to 6.6 pct yr/yr in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Greek inflation eases to 6.6 pct yr/yr in Feb.

text.p: Greece's consumer price inflation fell to 6.6 percent year-on-year in February from 6.8 percent in January, said Nickos Karavitis, general secretary of the National Statistics Service (NSS).
The exact figure was 6.59 percent, he said.
EU harmonised CPI-inflation for Greece was running at 6.6 percent year-on-year in January 1997, said Eurostat. The national consumer price inflation figure was 6.8 percent.
